The IE520 Series are hardened stackable Layer 3 switches for integration into video surveillance applications. The IE520 Series extends the Industrial Ethernet portfolio making the IE Series a versatile solution for both access and distribution network. The IE520 Series is designed to withstand environmental conditions found in outdoor deployment and spaces within buildings that lack mechanical heating, cooling, or humidity regulation. This device is fully qualified for use in railway (signalling and telecommunication), roadway transportation (traffic control) and video surveillance in outside plants.

==Overview== ===The Platform=== IE520-28GSX is an industrial grade entry level layer 3 stackable switch. It is designed to provide industrial application support and withstand hash environmental conditions. Virtual chassis stacking provides resiliency upto 4 units. ===Testing Strategy=== As IE520 is similar to x320 switchip and Phy chip similar to x230-28GS V2, extensive testing on the existing feature can be minimised. Focus on industrial feature testing can be extended, further detailed in feature testing section below. All the testing will be carried out on IE520 stack in the following order to address any memory issues: #Sanity and exploratory testing as soon as device is available #Bootloader and Factory test #Testing exisiting features available - ART and manual #New features #Interoperability with other devices ===Concerns=== Time constraint and conflict with rest of the projects lined up around the time. ===Security Implications=== Not listed in the TPS, software TPM is present. ==Test Coverage== ===Significant New Hardware Elements=== IE520 has similar switchip and memory to x320 platform, with 24 X SFP ports and 4 X SFP+ ports. *Reset Button *Port status LEDs *Dual DC power input- PW1 and PW2 *Terminal block for alarm relay output ===Platform Coverage=== IE520 will be tested against the following switches: *IE520 *IE360 or IE560 *IE570 if available at the time *Any marvel platform ===Feature Coverage=== All the existing feature listed in [[IE520 Software TPS]] will be tested on IE520. As mentioned earlier focus can be extended on testing industrial application listed below: *EtherNet/IP *Profinet *Modbus *PTP *BACnet Broadcast Management Device (BBMD) - YTD *no switchport capability- not supported, not listed in the TPS, confirmed from software- request to update TPS. *Jumbo frame size 9k *Memory leakage test ===Reference Platform=== Switch chip used in IE520 (PonCat3 98DX3336) which is similar to x320 platforms.The Phy chip used (1548P) is similar to one used in x230-28GS V2. ===Limits=== Refer to section "11.5 Ranges and Limits" in [[IE520 Software TPS]] . Limit testing will be covered as part of automated testing and fewer manual testing as required, results will be submitted to ART to updated to the database and LID. ===Licenses=== ''Base and feature license tests will be carried out to verify the listed feature is enabled and configurable. Internal full license is used to carry out all feature testing.'' ==Not Tested== Refer to " 11.4 Supported features (Ref. PRD Software Requirements)" in [[IE520 Software TPS]] ==Risks Table== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !'''Risk''' !'''Mitigation''' |- |Resource availabilty |request for early resource allocation |- |} ==Aspect of Testing== ===Tools=== *Ixia ports -1G and 10G support *Power supplies for all available DUT ===Test Cases=== Test cases will be store in Jira under 5.5.6-2---> Tomahawk---> IE570 *Existing features: previous test cases can be cloned and reused ===ART=== Existing automated test suites will be used which includes various features and limit testing, limit test results will be handed over to update the database and LID. Tests are run on below setup: *Simple setups ===Validation=== Before delivery to main, validation task will be raised to test project build before delivery. ===Test Pool=== Request for resource will be raised, based on the software and hardware availability. ===Global Involvement=== NA ===Schedule=== Scheduled to release for 5.5.6-1 ===References=== *[[IE520 Software TPS]] *[https://intranet.atlnz.lc/projects/ATLNZ/Current/3275_IE520/PRD/IE520_prd_1.0.pdf IE520 PR] [[Category:Test]] [[Category:Template]] [https://intranet.atlnz.lc/projects/ATLNZ/Current/3275_IE520/PRD/IE520_prd_1.0.pdf D] *[https://intranet.atlnz.lc/projects/ATLNZ/Current/3275_IE520/Hardware/Specifications/HW-TPS/AT-IE520-28GSX_HWTPS_v0.3.00_20260408-1.pdf IE520 HW_TPS] *[[Product Overview]]
